cases: Lost part ACK, exact positive inventory, durable protocol acceptance, cold native completion preserving the opaque token with no duplicate PUT. The retained concurrent CLI tests cover same-invocation continuation and remaining-part progress.
Missing/truncated/wrong checksum/identity/size/token, duplicate or nested XML, denied and absent upload responses preserve uncertainty.
Cancelled, expired or authentication-revoked authority, insufficient memory/wire reserve, and final-operation exhaustion refuse unauthorized contact.
Deadline crossing during the GET cannot restore active uploading.
Cold terminal status and historical indeterminate owners need neither source nor credentials and do not contact the provider.
With one operation left, part recovery refuses without spending it; with two, recovery can leave a successful final Abort. Uncertain Complete/Abort may still spend their last operation.
